protocol: Owner-approved durable operation fence per tenant, explicit operation/version and provider-account namespace; it remains active through uncertain dispatch, SCA, paid-but-unconsumed and compensation. Tenant row lock is the common serialization boundary, not a prospect or LDA-ID lock.

Lock order tenant -> operation -> prospect -> client. Recheck current member/role/tenant/client authority and actual capacity inside the transaction. Preserve existing standard_user create/convert and user_admin update/LDA roles; payment still requires BillingActorGuard. Receipt actor delegation is absent and must not be invented.

Use a separate persisted dispatch-intent journal for prepare/confirm/compensate with exact request hash, stable key and before-provider CAS. The existing immutable confirmationAuthorization is consent, never proof of dispatch. No DB transaction spans provider I/O. A worker lease expiring cannot release a may-have-dispatched operation or authorize a different-key replay.

Publication requires a monotonic database revision/CAS, durable authoritative observation and current operation validation after network readback. Delivered event snapshots and event.created are not ordering authority. Reuse signature verification and stripe_events; use database operation/receipt CAS for duplicates, different event IDs and crash replay.

Withhold candidate provisional quantity/status from canonical entitlements. Do not blanket-freeze unrelated cancellation/delinquency or comp overrides: invalidate/hold the operation and publish authoritative negative/admin policy using existing rules. Ambiguous provenance stays blocked for owner reconciliation; do not infer the cause from status alone.

Onboard alone verifies provider settlement and publishes paid quantity plus an exact prospect-bound reservation atomically under tenant lock. Core alone owns client insert/prospect link and consumes that reservation in the same Core database transaction. Ordinary manual/Meri/CSV/LDA/reactivation must not spend reserved capacity. Paid attempt remains immutable; separate operation reservation/consumption state survives it.

Core conversion retry returns the same consumed client and receipt identity without consuming twice. New client insertion failure rolls back reservation consumption and link, retaining paid reservation for retry; no Stripe call occurs in Core transaction. Existing-client link uses no new slot and cannot silently consume a paid reservation.

Before preparation recovery, use persisted exact target subscription/item/customer, request key/hash and authoritative paged provider object discovery. If IDs/correlation are missing or multiple candidates match, keep unresolved and require operator handling. Before confirmation recovery, exact saved invoice/intent/authorization readback is necessary. Do not replay just because a timestamp/lease expired.

Compensation is a separately recorded owner-approved action with exact unpaid invoice/subscription readback, its own stable key and journal. Do not void a settled payment, blindly restore a previous quantity over an external update, calculate credits or auto-refund. Release fence only after independently verified compensation or exact consumption.

Admission checks for new Checkout/Portal/lifecycle/provisioning operations must participate. Previously issued URLs/provider dashboard/automation cannot be fenced by the database. Verify actual provider configuration and exclusive mutation policy before activation; a fingerprint preflight is not an atomic provider compare-and-swap.
